keyFindings: Runtime unit IDs reused workbook-local labels across independent conditions; import now condition-qualifies those IDs when the packet explicitly states that no repeated identity is implied.
Ordered-axis units were previously hard-coded to hours; personal OPTO data now preserve seconds and CRYO data preserve minutes.
PFR025 cannot preserve within-cell pairing between activated and non-activated regions from the available runtime identity and is scientifically compromising for inference.
PFR069 is a single-cohort descriptive trajectory; inferential completion would require inventing a comparator or null value, so it is explicitly unsupported.
